title: ground-loop-writes-its-own-liveness
why: The foundation the other three children read. It is also the first device record ever to reach disk in Cairn — the runtime-spine sweep measured ZERO. That makes it layer 0 of that sweep's map and this ticket at the same time: a scan-and-post loop that finds nothing produces no output, so without this record 'ran and found nothing' and 'never ran' are the same observation from outside.

falsifier.proves_red: The record's last-run does not advance while the loop runs, or advances while it does not. And: the record must survive being read mid-write (a reader must never see a torn record) — atomic write, same discipline as the projector's append door.

proved_2026-08-09: The first device record ever to reach instance-space disk. liveness.py: atomic write (temp-then-os.replace, same dir) + the read face carrying the ruled 5s at its ONE class-space address (liveness.py:39) — absent/torn is DEAD with the lack named, never a raise. beat() gained the touch via construction-time liveness_home (the runner passes instance_home(); an anonymous in-process device — every pure-physics proof — has no device space and writes nothing, which is how the 8 pre-existing teeth stayed byte-untouched). __main__.py: the 46-line thin runner at the ruled 1s cadence, signal-clean, importing nothing but its own package. Live fire: separate-process reads watched last_run advance (beats 2->10, pid riding), and 6s after SIGTERM the verdict fell DEAD with the corpse's record returned whole — the crashed-loop detector working exactly as told. 13/13 teeth green twice + netns seal; verdict artifact verdict-20260809T110841-c93aee8392c8.json answers the chart (chain orient->validate 20260809, all deposited). The runner is session-mortal: the host-seam unit file keeping it alive across sessions stays the named IOU, out of these bounds.
string_correction_2026-08-09: The cast string omitted TICKETME — the chokepoint's own conformance check refused it (MalformedWorkflow, registered path THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> PROVED). Restored the missing stage with the cursor untouched at [THINKME]; the /sorted door now runs this parser at cast, so a drift like this dies there for every ticket cast after 2026-08-03.
intent: On each pass the ground loop writes a record in its own device space (~/.cairn/devices/ground_loop/<instance>/) carrying: when it last ran, its state, and its pid. The write is part of the pass, not a separate concern.

BUILDME.need: the ground loop rebuilt to Akien's 2026-07-30 ruling (scans each device's ~/.cairn/devices/<device>/<instance>/groundloop/ each beat and posts to the bus on a met trigger). Akien: 'once this is done, the very next intention is...' — this whole family sits downstream of that. decisions/2026-07-30-the-ground-loop-scans-disk-and-posts-to-the-bus.json

cursor_correction_2026-07-30: Cast with the cursor at [BUILDME], corrected to [THINKME] within the hour. A cursor AT a stage means that stage was ENTERED — superclaude-starts-itself rests at [PROVEME] with its BUILDME gate already satisfied — so [BUILDME] on a freshly cast leaf claims a crossing that never rode the chokepoint. It cannot have: since ticket buildme-rides-the-chart (2026-07-29) the entry gate refuses a BUILDME crossing unless a berthed validate packet claims the ticket, and a census of all 89 berths finds ZERO claiming any ticket in this family. Hand-writing the cursor forward is precisely the hand-edit of a record of truth that transitions.emit exists to prevent (Law 4). The stage is reachable only by /chart, then the door.
the_threshold_this_serves: THE STALENESS THRESHOLD IS 5 SECONDS — five missed ticks at the ruled once-per-second cadence. Ruled by Akien 2026-07-31. Three times the interval is the standard liveness heuristic; five gives slack for a loaded box without anyone noticing the lag. LIVE = last-run within 5s. DEAD = last-run older than 5s, whatever the file says about state, whatever pid it names. A crashed loop leaves the file behind but STOPS ADVANCING THE TIMESTAMP — that is the whole detector, and it is Akien's, present in the design from the first telling.
cadence_consequence: The write happens on EVERY pass, and the pass is once per second, so the write must cost near nothing and must be atomic — a reader inside a 5s window must never see a torn record and conclude DEAD. Write-temp-then-rename, the same discipline as the projector's append door.
